description: Bulk load from legacy system created duplicate site_ids. Approximately 212 duplicates found after Q4 2023 migration batch.
resolution: Manual dedup run by DBA team. 198 resolved, 14 disputed ownership.

description: 89 inspector records have NULL license_expiry after import from old HR system (PeopleSoft). Cannot determine if license is valid.
resolution: Sent to HR for manual verification. 61 updated, 28 still pending.

description: zone_code is NULL for all records created before 2022-01-01. Expected as per contract but flagged for awareness.
resolution: Accepted as known gap. Contract updated to allow NULL for pre-2022.

description: 34 records found with overall_status = 'PARTIAL' which is not in the allowed values list per contract v1.
resolution: PARTIAL added to allowed values in contract v2. Existing records kept.

description: 7 records have score > 100. Maximum allowed is 100.00. Suspected ETL calculation error.
resolution: ETL formula fixed. 7 records capped at 100. Root cause was divide-by-zero fallback.

description: Remaining 28 inspectors from INC-2024-0055 still have NULL license_expiry. Some may be actively conducting inspections.
resolution: Escalated to HR Director. Temporary hold on new assignments for affected inspectors.

description: report_submitted column has mixed casing: Yes/No/yes/no/YES/NO. Pipeline treats all as valid but downstream BI queries fail.
resolution: Normalisation job added to ETL. Historical records not cleaned.

description: 156 inspector records have emp_code as plain integers (e.g. 123) instead of EMP-XXXXX format. These are from pre-system records.
resolution: Migration script pending. Not yet executed.

description: 23 records where critical_findings > findings_count. Logically impossible — critical is a subset of total findings.
resolution: Bug in mobile app submit handler. Fixed in app v2.3.1. Historical records flagged.

description: 445 records have followup_deadline populated but followup_required = 0. Auto-populate script bug (DEV-4821).
resolution: Script fixed. Historical records not corrected — treat as unreliable.

description: 234 records have pincode with spaces or dashes e.g. '400 001' or '400-001' instead of '400001'.
resolution: Normalisation added to ingestion pipeline for new records. Backfill pending.

description: next_due_date is in the past for 112 active sites. Indicates either inspection is overdue or date was calculated incorrectly.
resolution: Investigation ongoing. Some are genuinely overdue, some are calculation errors.

description: 18 inspection records reference inspector_id values that do not exist in inspectors table. No FK constraint to catch this.
resolution: Orphan records quarantined. Source: manual data entry bypassing the application.

description: owner_contact mixes phone numbers and email addresses in same column. Downstream systems expect phone only.
resolution: Accepted as legacy design. New column owner_email to be added in next release.
